sourceFile: 2.2 BRS-161014 Report check problem Sub 2 CM+B-PT ( tension ) 2023.08.04_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it merges several distinct experiments and false metrics into one changed-factor case.
issues: Changed factor combines unrelated dates, sheets, lots, bonding amounts, insert tape, primer, press, SM, and wait-time tests.
Baseline/test condition is valid only for the CMG old-vs-new lot subset, not for the whole case.
Outcome grouping includes header/table-detection artifacts and malformed measurement candidates.
Row-level grouping keys such as sheet date, condition, SM status, time, and material lot are not preserved.
Evidence set is overbroad and cites unrelated context rows for claimed comparisons.
correctionPlan: Split into separate changed factors by test block and date context.
Keep CMG old Beijing Mag-Long vs new China Machine Building as its own supplier/lot comparison with rows 16.8!33, 16.8!35, 16.8!50, and 16.8!51.
Create separate comparisons for insert tape, bonding amount, primer cleaning, press use, SM status, and waiting time only where rows support them.
Trim evidenceRows to only rows directly supporting each factor and outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are row-level but overbroad; sufficient only after regrouping and removing artifacts.
